sections.title: Why SF Legal Organizations Choose ClickMasters

items.title: Attorneys worry about AI generating hallucinated legal citations — how does ClickMasters prevent this?
items.description: ClickMasters builds RAG-based legal research with source-grounding validation — the system retrieves from actual legal documents and attributes every claim to a source, rather than generating from LLM training memory. RAG legal research doesn't hallucinate citations because it doesn't generate citations — it retrieves and attributes them.
items.label: No hallucinations

items.title: How do we handle professional responsibility obligations around AI use?
items.description: California State Bar professional responsibility requirements around attorney supervision of AI work product are evolving — ClickMasters designs AI systems with attorney review workflows that keep licensed professionals in the loop for consequential outputs, consistent with current guidance.
items.label: Ethics

items.title: Can we deploy AI without sending attorney work product to OpenAI or Anthropic?

sections.title: Frequently Asked Questions
sections.description: Common questions from San Francisco legal organizations about AI development with ClickMasters.

items.question: Can legal AI actually save billable attorney time in measurable ways?
items.answer: Contract review AI that handles initial extraction and risk-flagging consistently reduces associate review time by 40–70% for routine contract types in published LegalTech studies. ClickMasters validates time savings on your specific contract types during a pilot engagement.

items.question: How does legal RAG ensure I'm retrieving from authoritative, current legal sources?
items.answer: Through controlled ingestion of authorized legal databases and internal firm knowledge — the RAG knowledge base is explicitly curated, not open internet, and is updated incrementally as new precedent and regulatory material is added.

items.question: Does ClickMasters have experience building AI for California-specific legal requirements?
items.answer: Yes — CCPA/CPRA compliance monitoring, California employment law contract review, and Prop 65 compliance AI are specific capabilities ClickMasters has delivered.

items.question: How long does legal AI development take?
items.answer: 10–28 weeks depending on application type and privilege-aware infrastructure requirements.

items.question: Can AI do more than extract data — can it actually advise on risk?
items.answer: AI can flag high-risk clause types based on pattern matching and classification; substantive risk assessment and legal advice requires attorney judgment that AI surfaces for but cannot replace.

items.question: Does ClickMasters work with LegalTech startups or only law firms?
items.answer: Both — law firms and in-house legal departments building internal tools, and LegalTech companies building AI-powered products for the legal market.
